title: Welcome to CIS 5200!
body: Our first lecture is on Wednesday, August 26 in Leidy Laboratories 10. Please make sure you have access to Ed, Canvas, and Gradescope before class.

title: Homework 0 released
body: Homework 0 is out. It is checked for completion only and is due Wednesday, September 16, when Homework 1 is released. Use it honestly to gauge how comfortable you are with the linear algebra, calculus, probability, and Python the course assumes.

title: Syllabus and schedule posted
body: The full course schedule, including lecture topics, recitations, and assignment due dates, is now available on the Schedule page.
